children: Teladoc Health has hired Michael Grasher as the telehealth company's new chief financial officer.
Teladoc on Monday said Grasher most recently served as finance chief of property-casualty insurance organization IFG Cos.
Teladoc's previous chief financial officer, Mala Murthy, left the company late last year.
